name: glm-tp2
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. GLM-5.3-Flash 2.25bpw as a two-rank tensor-parallel group (lane L2b, docs/GLM_TP.md): N1 = rank 0, N4 = rank 1, each owning half of the routed experts (0..144 | 144..288). With lane L2b's binary each rank holds the WHOLE pack (92 GiB on disk, 87 GiB of text weights); from lane L9 on, a rank maps and allocates only its share (46.3 GiB: docs/GLM_TP.md section 8). Text only and greedy-exact by construction: --no-vision, --prefix-cache off, --spec none, pinned --slots and --kv-tokens (the group plans before it loads). N2 and N3 are the gn100s: disabled by owner rule, listed so that a rank map naming them is refused.
